restaurant_name: Dentalme Clinic – CMU (Punna) สาขา หน้ามช.
text:
I visited this clinic recently to inquire about the cost of a dental scaling procedure. As I’m eligible for coverage under Thailand’s Universal Health Scheme (Gold Card), I was hoping to use that entitlement. However, I was quite surprised when the staff informed me that the price for scaling alone would be 5,000 THB.

I was also told that if I combined the scaling with a teeth whitening treatment, the total would be 6,000 THB. Unfortunately, there was no clear explanation or itemized breakdown of these charges, which left me feeling a bit unsure about the pricing structure.

What added to the confusion was the signage at the front of the clinic indicating that government health insurance is accepted. From my understanding, basic scaling should be fully or partially covered under this scheme, and even private clinics usually charge significantly less than what I was quoted.

I had also been considering additional services such as teeth whitening and a new retainer, but the lack of clarity around pricing made it difficult to make an informed decision.

I hope the clinic can improve the transparency of its pricing and provide more detailed information regarding the use of health coverage, as this would help patients feel more confident and informed about their treatment options.

text:
TL;DR: very, very highly recommended. The service and the prices are so good I will come back here from Europe for any major procedures.

Long version: I am a regular customer. Came here the first time because I live next door, keep coming back for everything tooth-related because they have amazing, professional doctors for very reasonable prices. Calm, professional, explain what they plan to do and why, never push you to some expensive procedure if there is a cheaper and less invasive way to solve the problem. There is a good reason this place has practically only five-star reviews, and it is mainly their doctors.

Example: I just came back from getting 5 necessary fillings there. As a completely extra side-effect, every tooth the Doctor had to touch now looks like new. Literally better than any other tooth in my mouth that hasn't been treated here. Because the doc happens to be a restoration specialist, and it feels like he just can't help it but to make it look good. Painless procedure, despite us agreeing on no anasthetics for today. With complicated problems, the doctor thinks about them and tells you later (sometimes next visit two weeks later!) "oh, I thought about this tooth and, what I said earlier might not be necessary, I can do it this-and-that way".  Or, sometimes, "I think we should leave it alone, because nothing I can do with this tooth will make it structurally better, and you have no problems right now."
I think that is simply an amazing service, for many reasons.

Unfortunately, I have to move back to Europe soon, but given the difference in price, service, and outcome, for anything complicated I will probably literally come back here, despite the travel costs and duration.  I might not save much due to the flight, hotel, etc, but at least I know that I will get a better job done here than practically anywhere else I have ever been before (and my sample size is, unfortunately, quite staggering due to how bad my teeth are, and how often I change cities and countries).
